Exact polynomial positivity certificate for the three-coupon second-sibling variance.
Let x,y>=0, z>0; a=(z+x+y)/(x+2*y+3*z), b=(z+y)/(x+2*y+3*z), c=z/(x+2*y+3*z).
Then (7/12)-Var(U) = P(x,y,z) / [12*(y+2*z)^4*(x+y+2*z)^4*(x+2*y+2*z)^4*(x+2*y+3*z)^4].
P is homogeneous of degree 16. Every displayed coefficient is strictly positive, and no monomial has x=y=0.
All other degree-16 monomials have coefficient zero.
Every row lists powers (i,j,k) and coefficient of x^i*y^j*z^k.
